in_hebrew.name: Alexandr
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Defender of the people
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Alexandr הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Alexandros', composed of 'alexein' meaning to defend and 'andros' meaning man. This name was popular among ancient Greeks and Romans, and was given to those who protected their communities. The name is also found in the Bible, where Alexander the Great is mentioned.

in_greek.name: Alexandr
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Defender of the people
in_greek.long_meaning: Alexandr είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name 'Alexandros', composed of 'alexein' meaning to defend and 'andros' meaning man. This name was popular among ancient Greeks and Romans, and was given to those who protected their communities. The name is also found in the Bible, where Alexander the Great is mentioned.

in_latin.name: Alexandr
in_latin.meaning: Latin name derived from Greek origin, meaning defender of the people
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Latinum a Graeco origine, significans defender populi. Alexandr erat nomen masculinum, quod a Graecorum gentibus usum est. Etymology: a- (privative) + lex (law) + andros (man). Origine: auctoritate Imperatoris Alexandri Magni, qui imperium Romanum extendit. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Alexandr significat protector populi Dei et servus Christi.
